papers.title: PhoenixNest-Video: Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Agent Framework for Automated Video Interview Assessment
papers.reason: The paper's structured working memory is an AI agent's internal state rather than human or animal cognition.

papers.title: NS-Copilot: An LLM-Driven Agent System for Autonomous Neuroscience Analysis
papers.reason: The system supports EEG and working-memory spike decoding, but its central contribution is an automated neuroscience-analysis platform rather than findings or models of executive function.

papers.title: Thinking effort aligns between humans and reasoning models in abductive reasoning
papers.reason: The paper explicitly benchmarks and compares the reasoning behavior of large reasoning models with human cognitive performance.

papers.title: Using eye tracking to explore the relationship between autism traits, joint attention, cognition and adaptive functioning in preschool children
papers.reason: The study relates eye-tracked joint-attention measures to autism traits, cognition, adaptive functioning, and intervention outcomes in a clinical population.

papers.title: Cognitive impairment and associated factors among adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus in eastern Sudan: a cross-sectional study.
papers.reason: The study uses MoCA to estimate general cognitive-impairment prevalence and correlates without specifically examining executive function or digital biomarkers.

papers.title: Combined hyperbaric oxygen and repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation for vascular cognitive impairment: a randomized controlled trail.
papers.reason: The trial combines cognitive outcomes with fNIRS evidence in vascular cognitive impairment, but it addresses broad rehabilitation effects rather than executive-function mechanisms.
